seoTitle: Sitemap Priority and Changefreq Distribution Chart
metaDescription: Show how often each priority and changefreq value appears in a sitemap as a bar chart. Spot meaningless defaults. Free.
intro: Counts priority and changefreq values and draws them as bars.
why:
If every URL has priority 0.5 or the same changefreq, the values say nothing. Google ignores both anyway, but other tools and engines may read them.

The chart makes a flat distribution obvious. Use it as a quick audit of what a CMS plugin wrote.
howTo: Decide whether to set real values or drop the fields.

faq.a: Google states it ignores priority and changefreq.
Other consumers of the file may use them, and defaults show a lazy generator.
No, it is text bars you can copy.
